svg.title: MorphX system architecture
svg.desc: A device process (acquisition loop, SQLite outbox, sync loop, status endpoint) uploads over HTTP to a server process (ingest, SQLite storage, read API, dashboard). A browser polls the status endpoint, the read API and the dashboard. Eight numbered steps show the path of one record.

text.tspan: Two processes, one HTTP link, SQLite on both sides.
makes event_id, sample_id and the 3 values once
survives kill -9, a crash and a power cut
200 / 201 → mark synced, send the next at once
error, timeout, 5xx → keep it, back off 1 to 30 s
received_at is set once, by the server
validate: units, UTC time, ids, number types
